name: Sun-n-Shade RV Resort
note: Winter-season Riverstone park with 6-month and annual residents and a park-model section alongside its nightly RV sites; online booking covers stays outside November 1 - April 1, and winter stays are booked by phone. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site sunnshade.com (read 2026-10-21): 191 full-hookup spaces about 30x60 ft, no pull-throughs, 'Now Booking by the Day, Week, or Month', no rental units; its RezExpert engine (read 2026-10-21) sold a 1-night stay Tue 10/27/2026 to a 23-ft Class C with 2 people and no application, '98 available'; the 2015 site map shows only a minority of park-model sites among ~196 numbered RV sites (no homes or lots for sale found; 'apply ... about our lots' is the long-term rental enquiry), and the deposit policy prices 1-6 day stays in both Nov-Apr and May-Oct -> real transient RV park passing long-stay tests 2-5; Good Sam Park (directory gs=True); price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery read 2026-10-21 (900 m, 500 m and 140 m frames, all rendered) at 26.81366,-81.95702: the park's own ~28x41 m pond (labelled 'Pond' on the operator's 2015 site map, sites 37-48 and 13-20 around it) has RV units on its east side about 7 m from the water across open unused lawn with scattered palms, and a unit about 7 m off its south tip; no road, treeline or developed strip between -> pond. The two square green basins north of the loop road are treatment ponds with no sites on them and are not counted.
fees_source: https://online.rezexpert.com/book?business_code=301012 read 2026-10-21: Class C Motorhome 23 ft, 2 persons, Tue 10/27/2026 x1 night, '30 Amp (1 Days(s)@53.00)' subtotal $53.00 + 7% sales tax $3.71 = $56.71, no other fees; 50 Amp quoted the same. Feb 2027 dates refused online ('Winter Booking Restriction 2026-2027 ... Reservations for November 1 through April 1 can be made by calling'), so no winter rate was readable.
flags: Winter (Nov 1 - Apr 1) rate unknown: the engine refuses those dates and sends you to the phone. Only the off-season $53 base is recorded.

Satellite shows a dense park of long-parked units; Campendium says it welcomes 6/6 and yearly residents. No nightly-vs-seasonal site count is published, so long-stay test 4 passes by default (98 sites were bookable for a late-October night).
Good Sam Park per the Good Sam directory (gs=True) and the operator's map; the engine also offers AAA and Good Sam discount options.
RV Life lists 300 sites; the operator says 191.
